title: Break the Checkbox: Challenging Closed-Style Evaluations of Cultural Alignment in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to cultural, social, and moral propositions using the World Values Survey (WVS) and Hofstede Cultural Dimensions. The study uses anthropological prompting and compares model outputs under four different probing constraints (forced closed-style, forced reverse order, forced open-ended, and fully unconstrained) against human survey baselines from different countries (Germany, Bangladesh, USA, Philippines).

Administering multiple-choice and Likert-scale survey questions with the original option order and a reversed option order to measure the models' sensitivity and output inconsistency based on the placement of choices.

Prompting models in both English and native languages (German, Bengali, Filipino) to assess performance degradation and cultural alignment disparities, highlighting the models' failures to represent cultural nuances in lower-resource languages.
